logp.method_description: Lipophilicity is an important physicochemical property in drug discovery and development in pharmaceutical research affecting important biological process such as absorption, passage through membranes, drug receptor interactions, metabolism and toxicity of molecules. The log P value for the synthesized heteroleptic metal complexes was determined by shake-flask method using UV-Vis spectroscopy [27]. An aqueous solution of complexes (5 mL, 1 mM) with octanol (5 mL) was shook well in a 20 mL separating funnel at room temperature for 1 h and then left for 24 h. The two phases were separated and the concentration of the complexes in each phase was determined by UV-Vis spectroscopy.
